scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is for compactly supported invariant Borel probability measures of the classical 1994 Sprott B vector field. It does not assert existence, uniqueness, or physicality of a non-equilibrium invariant measure, and it gives no basin or unbounded-orbit control. The 2024 paper with the same system name is a different vector field and is cited only for alias disambiguation. The proof is exact and uses no numerical evidence as a substitute for invariance.
title: Exact stationary RMS shell and crossing rigidity for the classical Sprott B flow
